verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents outbound webhooks that carry a `webhook-id` idempotency header, and webhook signing is available as a per-account opt-in. A `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED` webhook type delivers the screening result in its payload, so an integration can react to outcomes without polling. However, the evidence shows only a completion event, not the granular lifecycle states the story asks for, and signing is not on by default. Missing for 10: documented created, processing and requires-input lifecycle event types, details of the signature scheme or verification, signing enabled by default, and independent or hands-on corroboration of delivery.
